The service to the school is at 1250 A (amperes).

en:
High-resolution Energy and effect data from measurements made at Dansmästaren - a mobility house built by Uppsala Parkering in Uppsala municipality. The building has approx. 400 parking spaces in the parking area, of which approx. 60 are charging stations for electric car charging. In the building there is a 120 kWh, 60 kW output energy storage and solar cells on the roof comprising approx. 50 kW. An energy management system takes care of the energy flows and the need for power in the parking part of the building, which also has student housing and a grocery store.
Data is presented in csv format and via API in associated distribution.

Ett energihanteringssystem tar hand om energiflödena och behovet av effekt inom parkeringsdelen av byggnaden i vilket även studentbostäder samt en livsmedelsbutik finns.
Data presenteras i csv format samt via API i tillhörande distribution.
